name: rag
description: Retrieval-augmented generation over a local pgvector store: ingest documents, then answer questions from that corpus. Runs locally with in-database embeddings.

launcher.title: Postgres MCP launcher
launcher.description: Command that starts a stdio Postgres MCP server already pointed at your RAG database, split on spaces (e.g. `nix-mcp-postgres` on the kattakath fleet). Falls back to $RAG_POSTGRES_COMMAND; with neither, the server does not start and says why.
